605:t_019:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You certainly do love to run your mouth.」

605:t_019:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you're $$サイデリアル$$'s enemy...」

605:t_019:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll dispose of you before $c, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! And you, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$!」

605:t_019:12.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「On that point alone, I agree with you, $$サイデリアル$$.」

605:t_020:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you $$アムブリエル$$? Or are you $$西条涼音$$?」

605:t_020:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You shouldn't make such tactless remarks to a lady!」

605:t_020:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warriors of salvation, travelers toward $$太極$$, guardians of the law, keepers of causality, cursed wanderers...」

605:t_020:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So you too choose the path of defying me, just as they did.」

605:t_020:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Vanish at the end of causality!」

605:t_022:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Her existence has been erased. There is no need for two Reactors of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

605:t_023:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you $$アムブリエル$$? Or are you $$西条涼音$$?」

605:t_023:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You shouldn't make such tactless remarks to a lady!」

605:t_023:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Warriors of salvation, travelers toward $$太極$$, guardians of the law, keepers of causality, cursed wanderers...」

605:t_023:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So you too choose the path of defying me, just as they did.」

605:t_023:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Vanish at the end of causality!」

605:t_024:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Amazing...! You managed to react to that attack...!」

605:t_024:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Is this another result of your special training?!」

605:t_024:5.en:
$n
(Nobody... has noticed... that this is... a repeat of what just happened...)

605:t_024:6.en:
$n
(Am I the only one... who knows time rewound...?! )

605:t_024:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...$n... You have opened a forbidden door.」

605:t_024:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「So that is what the $$いがみ合う双子$$ mean...」

605:t_024:9.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It was worth coming here.」

605:t_024:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Huh...? But we haven't done anything yet...」

605:t_024:11.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Is that what felt strange just now...?」

605:t_024:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What happened, $$アウストラリス$$?!」

605:t_024:13.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「We withdraw. First, we will assess the situation.」

605:t_024:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If that's what you say, I'll obey.」

605:t_024:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What are you saying?! If we leave that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ alone any longer...」

605:t_024:18.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Our opportunity will come soon. We will settle everything then.」

605:t_025:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「At that moment... all twelve $$スフィア$$s united to reject me...」

605:t_025:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm disappointed, $$アサキム$$.」

605:t_025:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You truly are different from me.」

605:t_025:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You too are my target.」

605:t_026:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I see... That is your choice.」

605:t_026:3.en:
???
「He is not the only one who refuses to obey you!」

605:t_027:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's been a long time since I sat in this seat.」

605:t_027:1.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$?! How on earth did you get here?!」

605:t_027:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I teleported. It's something like a more powerful version of your $$ブーストアップ$$, $n.」

605:t_027:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「My other self says, 'Thank you for saving me.'」

605:t_027:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She and I became one. Yes... just as you went beyond hope and despair, $n.」

605:t_027:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You accepted her existence and saved me as I was sinking into the depths of consciousness. That's why we were able to become one.」

605:t_027:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Show me too, $n. Your power... the power of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$!」

605:t_028:0.en:
$n
「This power...! It surpasses what $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ could do before!」

605:t_028:2.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I won't hesitate anymore!」

605:t_028:3.en:
$n
「You took Dad and Sis's lives and shot Miss $$スズネ$$! You're my enemy!」

605:t_031:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... This is the same power you used.」

605:t_031:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though in its current state, I can't use it that many times.」

605:t_031:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're playing dead again, your favorite trick?!」

605:t_031:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then we'll just have to crush you completely!」
